name: Rolling Hamsphere
oracle_text:
This Vehicle gets +1/+1 for each Hamster you control.
Whenever this Vehicle attacks, create three 1/1 red Hamster creature tokens, then it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of Hamsters you control.
Crew 3
blocked_sentences: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, create three 1/1 red Hamster creature tokens, then it deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of Hamsters you control.

needs.what: a 1/1 red Hamster creature token (no abilities), e.g. id hamster_1_1_r
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has 1/1 red Goblin, Warrior and Elemental-with-haste tokens but no Hamster; the creature type matters because both the static buff and the damage X count Hamsters you control. The rest of the card is expressible: a buff static with power/toughness {count: {controller: you, subtypes: [Hamster], zone: battlefield}}, an attacks trigger on self with create_token then damage to an any-target target with the same count, and Crew 3 as tap_permanents total_power 3
